Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
public class NonRepeatedDigitsCount {
    public static int nonRepeatedDigitsCount(int input1) {
        int count = 0;
        ArrayList<Integer> nums = new ArrayList<Integer>();

        while(input1 != 0){
            int digit = input1 % 10;
            nums.add(digit);
            input1 /= 10;
        }

        for (int num : nums)
            if (Collections.frequency(nums, num) == 1) count++;

        return count;
    }
}
